data.summary: The components directory contains two shared React/TypeScript UI components for the mgr-web frontend: AgentAssignControl, a specialized widget for selecting sandbox agent subsets, and Dialogs, a reusable modal dialog kit. Both are leaf-level presentation components consumed by multiple pages (EditPage, SandboxListPage, workspace pages) rather than containing business logic or data-layer code. They act as a small shared UI hub but carry no backend or API responsibilities.

file_insights.name: Dialogs.tsx
file_insights.summary: Provides shared in-app ConfirmDialog and PromptDialog components that replace the browser-native confirm() and prompt() calls. Both implement the project's overlay contract with Escape/scrim closing and focus management.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines two React components and their prop interfaces: ConfirmDialogProps and PromptDialogProps. ConfirmDialog replaces native confirm() with an accessible modal overlay supporting Escape and scrim-click dismissal, while PromptDialog replaces native prompt() with a focus-managed input dialog. Focus moves to the first control on open and returns to the opener on close.
file_insights.detailed_description: Dialogs.tsx is a reusable UI infrastructure component exporting ConfirmDialog and PromptDialog, used across the app for destructive confirmations and text prompts. It encapsulates accessibility behavior (role=alertdialog, focus trapping and restoration to the opener) and the .overlay.open > .dialog CSS contract defined by SandboxListPage and RegisterDialog. Because it is imported in multiple pages, it functions as a central shared presentation primitive, though it contains no business or data logic.
responsibilities: Render accessible confirmation modals replacing native confirm()
Render prompt input modals replacing native prompt()
Manage overlay open/close, Escape key and scrim-click dismissal
Handle focus movement on open and restoration on close
Expose typed prop interfaces for consumers

file_insights.name: AgentAssignControl.tsx
file_insights.summary: Renders the S2 agent-subset checkboxes (pi/claude/codex/opencode) shared by EditPage and the SandboxListPage profile popover. Encodes the null/[]/[...] wire shape semantics for agent selection.
file_insights.source_summary: Exports a React component plus helper functions agentLabel and agentSubsetSummary, which format agent identifiers and summarize selected subsets for display. The component manages the fixed-order agent checkbox list and translates between UI state and the verbatim wire shape (null, empty array, or explicit subset).
file_insights.detailed_description: AgentAssignControl is a domain-specific but presentation-focused widget implementing design §4.2, letting users pick a subset of agents for a sandbox profile. It maps the wire-format value (null = all agents, [] = zero agents, [...] = explicit subset) to checkbox state and back, never emitting null when the last box is unchecked. It is shared between EditPage and SandboxListPage, making it a small but reused feature component.
responsibilities: Translate between null/[]/[...] wire values and checkbox state
Provide agent label formatting and subset summary helpers
Emit empty array (never null) when the last checkbox is unchecked
